shortDefinition.en: A camera whose lens is built in rather than normally exchanged by the user.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 镜头与机身一体、通常不由用户更换镜头的相机。

en: Fixed-lens does not mean prime or fixed focus: a built-in lens can zoom and autofocus.
zh-cn: 固定镜头不等于定焦或固定焦点，一体式镜头也可以变焦和自动对焦。

example.en: GFX100RF has a built-in single-focal-length lens, not an interchangeable GF lens.
example.zh-cn: GFX100RF 使用一体式定焦镜头，不能像 GF 卡口镜头那样更换。

en: This category answers how a lens attaches. Ask separately whether its focal length changes and how it focuses. A brand or product-family name cannot establish lens compatibility; consult the specific model documentation.
zh-cn: 这个类别回答镜头如何连接机身，是否改变焦距与如何对焦是另外的问题。品牌或产品系列名称不能证明镜头兼容性，应查具体型号文档。
